name: Robeson
gaps: Parcels are AGOL Robeson County Parcels (PRIMARY CAMA) (https://services7.arcgis.com/miWUVbMhSUq6a8y1/arcgis/rest/services/Robeson_County_Parcels/FeatureServer/0). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 14307 rows; 12583 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
Pass 2 enrichment is from rural-oz-pass2 res (tax ok, sale ok). Pass 2 counted 975 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Robeson pass-2 tax fields are land and improvement assessed values. Those components are not summed into a total market or assessed value.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
